summary: Add daily alert creation trends endpoint with UTC day buckets and per-severity zero-filled counts.
scope_anchors: UTC calendar-day buckets for last N days (including current UTC day), oldest-first
bucket totals plus severity counts in Low/Medium/High/Critical order
400 ValidationProblemDetails for invalid or non-numeric days via existing query validation behavior
constraints: Aggregate by UTC date derived from CreatedDate, not local timezone.
Return exactly N contiguous daily buckets from (utcToday-(N-1)) through utcToday.
Each bucket must include total count and all severities even when zero.
Per-severity field order must follow existing summary convention: Low, Medium, High, Critical.
Invalid days (including non-numeric values or out-of-range 1..90) must produce 400 ValidationProblemDetails consistent with existing [ApiController] query validation behavior.
coverage_goals: Controller exposes /trends endpoint and delegates valid query requests with typed 200 response.
Query DTO validation enforces default/min/max days and model-binding failure path for non-numeric days.
Service/repository return oldest-first UTC day buckets with correct totals and Low/Medium/High/Critical severity counts including zero-fill behavior.
